provenance.notes: Hard-tier charged-messengers pair (08-PROPOSALS.md Set 5, APPROVED 2026-09-26): glutamic acid CID 33032 (neutral free acid as-registered per C3 - physiological zwitterion deliberately NOT synthesized; parallel policy to citrate Decision 5) + acetylcholine CID 187 (+1 quaternary N - the DEFAULT approved pick; imidazolium CID 444234 and tetramethylammonium CID 6380 alternates NOT substituted). Per-record citation per U1: 'PubChem Identifier: CID <CID>; URL: https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/<CID>'. Complex reference metadata: CC0 1.0 (wwPDB).

L-Glutamic acid, PubChem CID 33032 (C5H9NO4, 10 heavy, Charge 0 as recorded per approved C3 - the research's '-1' claim is INCORRECT for this CID). Complex: 2JFO Enterococcus faecalis glutamate racemase with D- and L-glutamate (GLU confirmed as a bound nonpolymer ligand - hits 2CT6/1J0F rejected at confirmation, verified 2026-09-26; paper DOI resolves 200). Neutral free acid: physiological zwitterion deliberately NOT synthesized; parallel policy to citrate (Decision 5). Carries h_bond rich (NH2 donor + 2 COOH donors; carboxyl + amino N/O acceptors), hydrophobic (C3 spacer). No salt bridge as-recorded; the set's salt-bridge slot is carried by acetylcholine.

Acetylcholine, PubChem CID 187 (C7H16NO2+, 10 heavy, Charge +1 as recorded - permanently charged quaternary ammonium; no pKa choice exists). The DEFAULT approved pick over imidazolium CID 444234 (both 3D-verified during 08-04). Complex: 9E3E Torpedo nicotinic acetylcholine receptor, diliganded (ACH confirmed in inventory - eight higher-ranked hits lacked ACH, walk recorded, verified 2026-09-26; paper DOI verified at rcsb.org, doi.org 403 bot-block per U2). Carries salt_bridge (permanently +1 quaternary N vs AA carboxylates - the set's salt-bridge carrier), cation_pi ligand-side (the NMe3+ quaternary case sits OUTSIDE the PLIP tertamine veto - veto requires exactly 3 non-H substituents; the boundary complement to guanidinium's boundary case), h_bond (carbonyl + ester O acceptors), hydrophobic.
